inputs: institution id, or a list of fee_published_id
outputs: per-fee lineage and evidence verdict: traced / relinked / untraceable / lineage broken / no stored text
document list with own-site and page-type findings
budget: deterministic, no paid calls; bounded to one institution or a stated list of fees
triggering_workflows: a customer, reviewer or James questions a fee or a schedule
before a report goes out (with report-reconciliation)
after a Magellan or Rosetta change that can relink documents
failure_behavior: A step that cannot run (no stored text, unknown site host) is reported as unknown for the fees it covers; the audit never substitutes a live page read for stored evidence.
approval_requirements: None to run (read-only). Takedowns stay with Hamilton's own checks and their 12-hour second look.
abstain_when: the institution has no completed stored text
the official site host is unknown (skip the own-site step)
a rate fee would be compared with a dollar figure
a takedown_pending second look is already open on the fee
